vendor/lenis-1.3.27.min.js is the unmodified browser build of Lenis (the smooth scroll).

  Package:   lenis 1.3.27 (the newest release on 2026-10-25; published 2026-10-15T15:44Z)
  File:      dist/lenis.min.js from the npm tarball, copied byte for byte
  Tarball:   https://registry.npmjs.org/lenis/-/lenis-1.3.27.tgz
  Integrity: sha512-QIHNH4LIfWyLfgH/5K0aTGZgyFJJ7GfHNcaH/AIgyKjb8gstLh5siNGvrVqz1w5ClLXzOvllBVk7vby8JzUVPQ==
             (npm's dist.integrity, checked against the downloaded tarball)
  SHA-256:   80f53e77f1c13e379fc246d2b5e299188e20bcb2b2fe7ebb13e8e8c7563a6da7 (the vendored file)

The filename carries the version because /vendor/ is served immutable for a year (vercel.json).
To upgrade: npm pack lenis@<new> in a scratch folder, check dist.integrity, copy
dist/lenis.min.js to vendor/lenis-<new>.min.js, update this file and the script tag on every
page that loads it (tests/vendor.test.mjs checks they agree), and delete the old file.

The package's licence follows, unchanged.
